in_sanskrit.name: Devaram
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: consisting of the two parts 'Deva' and 'Rama', where 'Deva' means 'god' or 'heavenly being', and 'Rama' means 'pleasing to behold' or 'delighting'

in_hindi.name: देवराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: consisting of the two parts 'देव (Deva)' meaning 'god' or 'heavenly being', and 'राम (Ram)' meaning 'pleasing to behold' or 'delighting'

in_tamil.name: தேவராம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: consisting of the two parts 'தேவ (Theva)' meaning 'god' or 'heavenly being', and 'ராம் (Ram)' meaning 'pleasing to behold' or 'delighting'

in_telugu.name: దేవరామ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: consisting of the two parts 'దేవ (Deva)' meaning 'god' or 'heavenly being', and 'రామ్ (Ram)' meaning 'pleasing to behold' or 'delighting'

in_marathi.name: Devaram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Devaram is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning God and ‘Rama’ meaning message. This name signifies the divine message from the Gods.

in_bengali.name: Devaram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's message
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devaram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Devaram is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning God and ‘Rama’ meaning message. This name signifies the divine message from the Gods.
